recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中紅血球母細胞（erythroblast）成群聚集，部分細胞呈雙核或核分葉、核碎裂狀，配合先天性貧血病史才會想到先天性紅血球生成不良性貧血（CDA）；本圖解析度偏低，多核型態無法完全確認。
features: Clusters of erythroid precursors with dense, dark round nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Occasional erythroblasts with two nuclear profiles or lobulated/fragmented nuclei suggestive of binuclearity and karyorrhexis
Erythroid precursors dominate the cellular clusters compared with granulocytic cells
Scattered larger mononuclear cells and a stromal/macrophage-like cell with an oval nucleus in the center
Background red cells without obvious blasts; image is low resolution and slightly blurred
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters of erythroid precursors that predominate among the nucleated cells. Several erythroblasts show irregular, lobulated or paired nuclear profiles suggesting binuclearity and nuclear fragmentation, with some nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. Granulocytic precursors are present without increased blasts. Image resolution limits confident assessment of multinuclearity and internuclear chromatin bridges. Findings are compatible with dyserythropoiesis and, in the appropriate congenital clinical setting, suggestive of congenital dyserythropoietic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS is acquired, usually in older adults, and shows multilineage dysplasia, increased blasts or ring sideroblasts and clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities rather than isolated lifelong dyserythropoiesis.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts are large with open, sieve-like chromatin and are accompanied by giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, correcting with B12/folate.
PEL shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) with >80% erythroid cells and marked atypia, not a maturing erythroid series with binucleate forms.
These show microcytosis, target cells and abnormal hemoglobin studies, whereas CDA II shows prominent binucleate late erythroblasts (HEMPAS, SEC23B) and CDA I shows internuclear chromatin bridges.
